Greatly enhance normal attacks 10 times and a strong attack will be activated after that. Unable to use redundantly." Lunar Slash Lv 5; One-Handed Sword/Two-Handed Sword only MP Cost: 400 Damage Type: Physical Base Skill Multiplier (First Hit): 10 Base Skill Constant (First Hit): 400 Base Skill Multiplier (Second Hit): (Total STR * Skill Level * 0.1)/100 Base Skill Constant (Second Hit): Base INT/2 Base Skill Multiplier (Stack Hit): (Total STR * Skill Level * 0.1)/100 Base Skill Constant (Stack Hit): Base INT Hit Count: 2 hits on main target; damage calculation is done for each hit Maximum Cast Range: Defaults to the weapon's Auto Attack Max Range Second Hit Ailment: Fatigue Second Hit Ailment Chance: 4 * Skill Level % Second Hit Ailment Duration: 10 sec Second Hit Ailment Resistance: None Skill Effect: - For THS only, Upon using this skill, it gives +(CC) Lunar Slash stacks. Which can be consumed to deal additional damage to the target. Using any attacking skills(except Lunar Slash) will consume 1 Lunar Slash stack to deal/trigger Stack Damage on the target. Max stack is up to 9. - Stack/Additional Hits has fixed Critical rate +(10 * Skill Level + CRT). Note: CRT is personal stats. - All hits of this skill can be affected by srd% and Sword Techniques. However, stack doesn’t get affected by combo tags. Game Description: “Slashes target and magic blade will deal additional damage after a slight delay. The magic blade may inflict [Fatigue].” THS Bonus: Performs an additional attack if another attack skill is used. This additional attack is unable to inflict [Fatigue], but Critical Rate increases according to the skill level. Even if your Lunar Slash attack got missed/evaded, this skill still gives stacks. If you hit multiple targets with AoE skill, then it will consume several stacks on multiple targets, 1 stack each target. CC refers to Combo count. Which is Opener(1CC) > 2CC > 3CC and so on.. Lunar Slash

If 2 or more targets are involved, the power will increase proportionally and consumed MP will be restored.” Storm Blaze T3; THS only MP Cost: 200 Base Skill Constant: 100 + Skill Level * 10 + Total Vit Base Skill Multiplier: (0.5 + Skill Level * 0.05) * Blaze Stack consumed Hit Count: 1 Maximum Cast Range: 16m Hit Range: Length of 16m and radius of (2 + 0.4 * Blaze Stack)m, from the caster towards the main target Skill Effect: • You will passively gain Blaze stack by 1 stack for every auto attack or 2 stacks if with Rampage auto attack. But upon use, you can consume up to 10 stacks only, for damage and mp gain formula. • Upon use, you will gain MP by (Blaze Stack consumed^2 * 3). Game Description: “Attacks enemies in a straight line with an aerial slash. Wind Power will accumulate when a normal attack hits. Wind Power is consumed upon skill activation. Overwriting won't trigger this recovery.” You cannot use this skill if you got “Guard Power Break” Garde Blade

Ogre Slash T5; THS only MP Cost: 500 Base Skill Constant (First Hit): Total Dex Base Skill Multiplier (First Hit): (Base STR + Base VIT)/100 Base Skill Constant (Second AOE Hit): 500 Base Skill Multiplier (Second AOE Hit): 2 * Ogre Stack Consumed Hit Count: 2 hits Maximum Cast Range: Defaults to the weapon's Auto Attack Max Range Second Hit Range: 2m around the target Skill Effect: • You will passively gain Ogre Stacks by: +Floor(Skill Level ÷ 2) when you are the first to engage in battle, +1 when targeted by a red/blue warning AoE (1 second + AoE duration of cooldown), +1 when taking damage (1 second of cooldown), and +1 from a perfectly timed guard. You can store up to 20 Ogre Stacks, but only up to 10 can be consumed per activation. • This skill has Physical Pierce by (10 * Ogre Stack Consumed)%; if this effect makes this skill’s total Physical Pierce exceeds 100%, every 1% excessive PP is converted to 0.01 bonus multiplier to the First Hit instead • The second AoE damage of this skill can be affected by SRD%, has a 1.5m explosion radius that bypasses guard, and detonates after 2.5 seconds. Second AoE proration is the same as the first hit proration. • During this skill animation, you’re immune to interrupt ail (Flinch/Tumble/Stun/Knockback) Buff Effect: • Double Rampage Auto Attack and Final Blow damage. • Mitigate Berserk Stability Penalty by 50%. So Berserk at Level 10, -25% stab will become - 12% stab. • Also, mitigate Def/Mdef% Berserk Penalty by 50%. • You will recover HP based on MP Bar consumption by (MP Bar Consumed ^ 2) * 100 HP • You will reduce 99% of the incoming damage during the animation of the last hits of Rampage. Buff Duration: 3 + 2 * Skill Level (10 + 5 * Skill Level) seconds. Game Description: “Deals damage to the target and after a short while, causes an explosion at the target's feet, dealing additional damage. If the conditions are met, Ogre Power will be accumulated and consumed upon skill activation to increase the power and buff.” Ogre Slash
